tips.title: Kiŋaren, kitub, kiteo
body: Recipes are full of commands with **ki-**: **Kiŋaren** first, **Kitub** cut, **Kiteo** put, **Kimedor** add. **Kinyamata oni!** is “let’s eat!”.

tips.title: Atabo, akim
body: **Atabo** is a cooking pot, **akim** fire, **akimiet** oil, **ibiliŋi** onions, **inyanya** tomatoes. **Abu aŋoon** is “I am full”.

culture.title: Cooking in Teso
body: Food is cooked on three stones over a wood fire. Groundnut paste, **emaido**, goes into many sauces, and millet **atap** is turned with a wooden stick.
